name: internetmonitor
description: Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor provides visibility into how internet issues impact the performance and availability between your applications hosted on Amazon Web Services and your end users.

subcommands.name: create-monitor
subcommands.description: Creates a monitor in Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor.

subcommands.name: delete-monitor
subcommands.description: Deletes a monitor in Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor.

subcommands.name: get-health-event
subcommands.description: Gets information that Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor has created and stored about a health event for a specified monitor.

subcommands.name: get-internet-event
subcommands.description: Gets information that Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor has generated about an internet event.

subcommands.name: get-monitor
subcommands.description: Gets information about a monitor in Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor based on a monitor name.

subcommands.name: get-query-results
subcommands.description: Return the data for a query with the Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor query interface.

subcommands.name: get-query-status
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of a query for the Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor query interface, for a specified query ID and monitor.

subcommands.name: list-health-events
subcommands.description: Lists all health events for a monitor in Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor.

subcommands.name: list-internet-events
subcommands.description: Lists internet events that cause performance or availability issues for client locations.

subcommands.name: list-monitors
subcommands.description: Lists all of your monitors for Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor and their statuses, along with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) and name of each monitor.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: start-query
subcommands.description: Start a query to return data for a specific query type for the Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor query interface.

subcommands.name: stop-query
subcommands.description: Stop a query that is progress for a specific monitor.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a tag to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource.
